stem: Meena's mother dissolved salt in water while cooking, and the solution was accidentally spilled into a clean steel bowl. Meena wants to recover the salt as a dry solid. Which method should she use?

options.text: Evaporate the water by gently warming the solution until the water has gone
Filter the solution through filter paper to catch the salt
Cool the solution in a refrigerator so the salt freezes out
Use a magnet to pull the salt out of the water

teacher.key_rationale: Salt is dissolved in water, so it passes through filter paper (B fails), is not magnetic (D fails), and cooling does not recover it as a dry solid (C fails). Evaporation removes the water, leaving the dissolved salt behind as a solid residue, so A is correct.
